source.title: GalaxyCore Multispectral Image Sensor from Mate 70 Pro+ Device Essentials Folder

pixel_pitch_um.evidence: search_description: The GalaxyCore multispectral image sensor with features of 1.5 MP resolution, pixel pitch of 1.75 µm, and 3 × 3 color filter pattern is a front illuminated (FI) CMOS image sensor extracted from Huawei Mate 70 Pro+ smart.

optical_format.evidence: html_design_snippet: This image sensor, extracted from the Techno Spark front camera, provides the features including 1/3.1” optical format, 32 MP resolution, and 0.70 µm pixel pitch.

model_limitations: Absorption-only CFA layer proxy; does not include full optical-stack interference, microlens focusing, grid diffraction, or silicon absorption.
Common R/G/B n,k proxy, not product-specific measured optical constants.

spectral_ranges.context: sides of the die Structure No apparent OCL coating in use No shift of outer pixels toward the array center Multispectral 3 × 3 color filter pattern Measured color filter thickness ranges from 0.85 µm to 1.1 µm (dependent on color and measured location) Optical stack height ~3.4 µm 330 nm deep shallow trench isolation (STI) used in the pixel array and periphery Non-silicided pixel array

notes: QE quantitative_points are reported text points, not reconstructed curves.
inferred_rule values are setup defaults and must not be treated as measurements.
